svg.title: Eighteen Branches, Then None
svg.desc: Runtime control flow with eighteen branches is erased by literal flags, slot, and axis operands, producing straight-line specialized assembly with zero branches and an SGPR cost.
svg.text: Constant operands change wavefront control flow — not just the instruction count
along with the test that chose it.
Both arms write the same fixed bit,
so the compiler picks the value,
s_cselect_b32 s18, 0, 0x2000 ; resolved with a SELECT, not a branch
s_bitset0_b32 s12, 13 ; mset of a constant slot: one instruction
grep over the whole specialized file: zero s_cbranch or s_branch
the eighteen deleted branches were replaced by s_cselects over folded literals, and those literals need scalar registers to live in.
